subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw core accept this native folder-backed encrypted snapshot backup flow and its new backup config surface once the safety and proof blockers are fixed?
rationale: The PR adds core CLI commands, persistent config keys, encrypted backup storage, and destructive restore behavior; code review can identify blockers, but maintainers need to confirm whether this product shape belongs in core before it is polished for merge.

options.title: Sponsor native snapshots after blockers
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate, require the safety repairs and real behavior proof, then re-review the exact head for merge.

options.title: Narrow to archive-only lifecycle
options.body: Reject the new folder-backed snapshot/config surface for now and keep the shipped local archive export/verify path as the core-owned backup scope.

options.title: Defer off-machine backup to plugins
options.body: Close or pause the native snapshot direction and steer cloud-drive or remote-backup workflows to ClawHub/plugin packages unless a missing core API is identified.

recommendation.title: Sponsor native snapshots after blockers
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the candidate, require the safety repairs and real behavior proof, then re-review the exact head for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent backup CLI/docs work and CODEOWNERS ownership make steipete the best available product-direction owner among the observed related people.
